label: v4 results archive (make_results_archive_v4.py): copies of v4 session folders for the supervisor and the paper. Read-only towards the run folders. Not part of the freeze (it lists run folders, which are added after the runs). Paths are relative to the robot_vision folder unless noted.
archive_root_note: Outside the repository (a folder next to it), the same place as the v3 archives. Override with --archive-root. Each build writes a new results_archive_v4_<time>/ and its zip; nothing is overwritten.

exclude.note: Model weights, avatar files (VRM, FBX) and Mixamo files are never archived (licences; weights are identified by SHA-256 in environment/models.csv). The leak-test images (.png) and the frames are copied.
